name: Baasha
overview: Baasha was a king of Israel who engaged in continual conflict with Asa, king of Judah, as seen in their lifelong war and Baasha’s military actions against Judah. He fortified Ramah to block passage to Asa, prompting Asa to seek an alliance with Benhadad, king of Syria, by sending him treasures to break Baasha’s hold. This alliance led to Syrian attacks on Israelite cities, forcing Baasha to abandon the fortification project and reside in Tirzah. These events highlight the political and military struggles during Baasha’s reign and the tensions between Israel and Judah.
